weakness.title: Insufficient Verification and Supervision of Visitor Access
weakness.description: The facility does not adequately verify the identity and purpose of visitors, or does not supervise them while they are inside.

extended_description.applicability: Facilities that admit persons who are not staff, such as guests, contractors, delivery personnel and auditors. Areas intended for open public access are not affected.
extended_description.exploitation: A person gains entry by presenting as a visitor, or a genuine visitor reaches areas beyond the purpose of the visit, because identity and purpose are not checked or the visit is neither accompanied nor limited.

row.details: Visitors can view or take information, media and equipment in areas they have no reason to reach.
Equipment can be altered by a person unknown to the organization.
The presence and movements of visitors cannot be established afterwards.

row.description: Check each visitor's identity and the purpose of the visit, and have the host confirm the visit before admission.
Record arrival and departure, and issue a visibly distinct visitor credential that expires at the end of the visit.
Restrict visitor credentials to the areas the visit requires.
Have a host accompany visitors in non-public areas, or confine them to defined zones.
Visitor records contain personal data and must be protected and retained as required by applicable law.

row.reference: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PE-8 Visitor Access Records
